Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is a book build issue of ₹49.81 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 93.98 lakh shares of ₹49.81 crore.

Axiom Gas Engineering IPO opens for subscription on Sep 18, 2026 and closes on Sep 22, 2026. The allotment for the Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 23, 2026. Axiom Gas Engineering IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 25, 2026.

Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is set issue price band at ₹50 to ₹53 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,12,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,18,000.

SKI Capital Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Sunflower Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Axiom Gas Engineering IPO RHP for detailed Information.

About Axiom Gas Engineering Ltd.

Updated on Sep 10, 2026

Incorporated in 2007, Axiom Gas Engineering Ltd. specialises in green energy engineering solutions. The company offers Auto LPG, CNG, and LNG solutions, catering to retail and industrial sectors with a commitment to quality, innovation, and environmental sustainability. The company operates 20+ Auto LPG Dispensing Stations (ALDS) under the name, "PRIMEFUEL" across multiple states in India including Telangana, Karnataka, and Maharashtra.

The company offers the following services:-

  • Gas and Pipe Engineering: Designs, implements, and maintains efficient gas systems for various industrial and commercial needs.
  • Turnkey Services:Provides turnkey services for LPG/CNG retail, bottling, and bulk installations from concept to completion.
  • Statutory Testing and Certification: Testing and Certification for hydrocarbon equipment, ensuring compliance with safety standards.
  • Technical Consultancy: Provide expert guidance on hydrocarbon equipment design and optimization.
  • Maintenance Operation and Training: Provides maintenance and training programs to enhance gas system longevity and performance.
  • Manufacturing Pressure Vessels Through Third-Party Collaboration.
  • Specializing in Industrial and Commercial LPG solutions.

Competitive Strength:

  • Expertise in Executing Projects in Challenging Geographical Locations.
  • Cost Optimization Strategies Without Compromising Safety Standards.
  • Innovation in Developing and Implementing Cost-Effective Technical Solutions.
  • Leveraging Global Engineering Resources to Deliver Superior Value.
  • Commitment to Delivering Sustainable Projects with Excellence in Health Safety and Environment.
  • Rapid Deployment Capabilities to Minimize Turnaround Times.
  • Cost-Effective Establishment of New Auto LPG Dispensing Stations (ALDS).
